content:
Alex: quick bench bringing up a new open 7B on A100 vs H100 — int8 PTQ, comparing prefill/decode latency, tokens/sec and $/1M tokens across us-west1 and eu-west1. sharing top-level notes.
Maria: can you drop the run config and kernel flags? interested in seq lengths / batch that drove these numbers.
Alex: cfg: model=llama-7b-open, quant=post-train int8, batch=8, seq=2048, prompt_prefill≈250 toks. kernels: H100 path used our fast-attn + fused-kernel, A100 hit generic attention path for some layers. run command: ```./bench_run --model=llama-7b --quant=int8 --batch=8 --seq=2048 --gpu=A100|H100 --prefill=250``` 
Kai: paste of results (tokens/sec  | prefill latency | decode ms/token | $/1M tokens):
```
A100  us-west1 : 45,200 t/s | prefill 230ms | decode 11.0 ms/tok | $/1M = $12.4
H100  us-west1 : 61,800 t/s | prefill 160ms | decode 9.0  ms/tok | $/1M = $10.1
A100  eu-west1 : 43,400 t/s | prefill 245ms | decode 12.0 ms/tok | $/1M = $13.1
H100  eu-west1 : 60,200 t/s | prefill 170ms | decode 9.5  ms/tok | $/1M = $10.8
```
Cheng: interesting signal — biggest win for H100 is prefill (memory-bandwidth + optimized fused kernels). decode improvement exists but is smaller. noticed A100 occasionally fell back to generic kernel on >1k seq which cost ~10% throughput.
Maria: how about quant quality? any regressions on our evals?
Kai: ran two quick eval suites: perplexity on 1k prompts and summarization Rouge-L on 500 examples. int8 PTQ + symmetric rounding => +1.3% perplexity, Rouge-L -0.7. small but measurable. added full logs: gs://redwood-evals/1717654321/ (contains eval artifacts and token-level diffs).
Alex: cost calc assumptions: spot estimates used A100=$2.6/hr, H100=$3.4/hr; cost per 1M tokens derived from t/s and per-hour cost => numbers above. region EC2-like pricing variance visible (eu region ~5-7% higher).
Cheng: capacity sizing note: for strict p99 latency SLO=300ms, A100 fleet needs ~30% extra headroom vs H100 for this workload at peak mix. recommendation: dedicate H100 for latency-critical customers; A100 OK for best-effort throughput/cost tradeoffs.
Maria: can we try q4f16 (4-bit) or bf16 post-quant to see quality vs cost? also toggle `--use-fast-attn` on A100 to test kernel path.
Kai: scheduling reruns tomorrow in eu-west1 with q4f16 + kernel flag. will also run longer seq slices (512/1024/2048) to check kernel fallthrough points.
Alex: FYI charts: pushed a quick histogram + tail-latency plot to https://dash.redwood.internal/s/bench/1717654321 (will add captions). early takeaways: H100 reduces tail by ~25% on prefill and improves tokens/sec by ~35% for this model+quant config.
deploy-bot: benchmark job 1717654321 finished (H100 us-west1) at 2024-10-12T09:12:34Z :white_check_mark:
Kai: will post the q4f16 run summary once complete. tagging @Maria @Cheng for follow-ups.
Maria: good baseline, thanks. next steps: quality sweep (1k prompts) + rerun with fast-attn on A100, then decide default quant profile for onboarding.
